section_risks: Professional Summary heading is missing or non-standard.
ats_improvement_actions: Do not add unsupported skills; instead strengthen truthful evidence around existing strengths and treat these as missing: Customer service.
Place the strongest role keywords naturally in the Professional Summary: Operations management, Team coordination, Reporting.
Keep the Skills section ATS-safe and grouped, highlighting: Operations management, Customer service, Team coordination, Reporting, Inventory control.
